6.description: [League 2] [Naxxramas] [Instructor Razuvious] Instructor Razuvious is now fully immune to disarm effects.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Instructor Razuvious] Instructor Razuvious is no longer able to critical strike his studies.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Instructor Razuvious] Taunt used by Death Knights Under Study causes Instructor Razuvious to attack the casting Death Knights Under Study. Taunt has a 30 seconds cooldown.

[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Instructor Razuvious] Shield Block used by Death Knights Under Study reduces the damage of Instructor Razuvious next melee attack within 4 seconds by 90%. Shield Block has a 12 seconds cooldown.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Instructor Razuvious] Shield Bash used by Death Knights Under Study can be used to interrupt Instructor Razuvious. This ability remains unchanged.

[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Instructor Razuvious] Plague Strike used by Death Knights Under Study reduces the targets attack power by an amount equal to other effects that reduce an enemies attack power at level 60. Plague Strike has a 20 seconds cooldown and does not stack with similar effects.

[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Instructor Razuvious] Frost Strike used by Death Knights Under Study reduces the targets attack speed by 20% for 10 seconds. Frost Strike has a 20 seconds cooldown and does not stack with similar effects.

[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Instructor Razuvious] Blood Strike used by Death Knights Under Study now also reduces the targets armor by 4%. Stacking up to 5 times. This does not stack with similar effects.

[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Instructor Razuvious] Death Knights Under Study now have a new set of abilities player can use while controlling them. Blood Strike, Frost Strike, Plague Strike, Shield Bash, Shield Block, Taunt.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Loatheb] Loatheb will now remove all active Impending Doom and Deathbloom from all player when reaching 20% health.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Loatheb] Inevitable Doom now pierces trough all forms of invulnerability.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Loatheb] Corrected an issue where Inevitable Doom would no display its correct damage values.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Loatheb] Deathbloom is now a disease and can be dispelled. Deathbloom now lasts for 12 seconds up from 6 seconds.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Loatheb] Fungal Creep applied by Spores during the Loatheb encounter no longer has a target cap and now also reduces all power costs by 50%.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Loatheb] Aura of Famine will now prevent all forms of unnatural power regeneration.

[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Loatheb] Necrotic Aura will no longer reduce healing over time effects retro active. A healing over time effect that is placed on the target while the Necrotic Aura is active will tick for its normal healing during the 3 second window the aura is faded.

[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Loatheb] Necroctic Aura will no longer prevent absorption effects. While Necrotic Aura is active, all of Loathebs attacks and abilities, including damage dealt by his Spores will pierce 90% of absorption effects.

[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Loatheb] Loatheb will now use a new ability called Wither. Wither reduces the targets health by 5% while letting Loatheb Grow increasing his physical damage by 5%. Wither lasts until the end of combat. Loatheb will not use Wither below 20% health.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Heigan the Unclean] Heigan the Unclean now makes sure that player participate in his fast dance phase.

[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Heigan the Unclean] Implemented a fail safe for Heigans Eruptions. If a player is hit by multiple Eruption at the same time, the damage of all Eruptions after the first is reduced by 99% for 250 milliseconds.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Heigan the Unclean] Poison Cloud no longer damages pets.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Heigan the Unclean] Reduced the radius of Poison Cloud to 12 yards down from 21. The Radius of Disrupting Aura has been reduced to 15 yards down from 21.

[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Heigan the Unclean] Heigan the Unclean will now use a new ability called Touch of the Unclean. Touch of the Unclean reduces the targets Stats by 11% lasts 40 seconds, stacking up to 9 times.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Noth the Plaguebringer] Corrected an issue where Wrath of the Plaguebringer would scale with the triggering players damage increasing and damage reducing effects.

[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Noth the Plaguebringer] Curse of the Plaguebringer now lasts for 8 seconds up from 5. A maximum of 5 targets will now be effected on Flex Mode and Heroic 10 player difficulty up from 3. A maximum of 12 targets will now be effected on Heroic 25 player difficulty up from 3.

[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Noth the Plaguebringer] Cripple no longer only reduces Strength by 100%. It now reduces all stats by 50%. Cripple no longer reduces melee haste. Cripple now lasts for 60 seconds up from 15.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Noth the Plaguebringer] Noth will now cast Cripple when he returns to the ground in addition to the cast when he teleport to his balcony.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Noth the Plaguebringer] Corrected an issue where Plagued Champions would try to hit themselves with their Mortal Strike ability instead of the player.

[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Noth the Plaguebringer] Noth will now summon both Plagued Champions and Plagued Guardians during all balcony phases. The number of creatures summoned will increase with each balcony phase.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Noth the Plaguebringer] Noth will now have a 75 second ground phase followed by 60 seconds on his balcony. His ground time will no longer reduce with each balcony phase.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Maexxna] Necrotic Poison (Maexxna Spiderling) now reduces healing taken by 99% up from 75%. This Necrotic Poison can still be dispelled.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Maexxna] Maexxna once again gains attack speed from Frenzy below 20% health. Frenzy will no longer increase Maexxnas size and should no longer cause her to reposition.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Maexxna] Web Wrap now inflicts 5% maximum health damage to its target per second.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Maexxna] Necrotic Poison can no longer be dispelled, and reduces healing taken by 10% down from 90%. Stacking up to 10 times.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Maexxna] Corrected an issue where A Grieving Mother would also increase Maexxnas Attack Speed by 20% for its duration.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Maexxna]  Reduced the effects of A Mothers Strength and A Grieving Mother to 10% down from 20%. A Grieving Mother will now last for 4 seconds up from 2.

[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Grand Widow Faerlina] The Widows Gift now also causes Naxxramas Worshipper to heal for 5000 health every second. This will prevent them from dying to early into the fight by standing in poison.

[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Grand Widow Faerlina] Naxxramas Worshipper Fireball now deals 10% of the targets maximum health in damage down from 15%. Cast time has been reduced to 2 seconds down from 2.5 seconds.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Grand Widow Faerlina] Poison Pools have their tick rate increased to 250 milliseconds up from 1 second. Damage has been adjusted accordingly.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Grand Widow Faerlina] Corrected an issue where Faerlina would prevent Poison Pools from spawning by reapplying Poison Bolt Volley to early.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Grand Widow Faerlina] Poison Bolt Volley no longer stacks.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Grand Widow Faerlina] Faerlina will now continue to use Poison Bolt Volley after being effected by Widows Embrace.

[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Grand Widow Faerlina] Grand Widow Faerlinas Frenzy ability now increases all of her damage dealt by 40%, down from 100% and attack speed by 20% down from 100%. Frenzy now stacks up to 5 times. Previously Frenzy would only increase Physical Damage.

[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Grand Widow Faerlina] Grand Widow Faerlina will now use a new ability, Malicious Strike after 5 minutes into combat. Malicious Strike deals 50% weapon damage to the target and increases its physical damage taken by 10%. Stacking up to 10 times. Lasts 30 seconds.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Grand Widow Faerlina] Grand Widow Faerlina will now reach her hard enrage after 10 minutes up from 5 minutes.

[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Anub'Rekhan] Anub'Rekhans Shadow Trap now has two instances of area damage. Lethal damage is applied within the visible animation of the trap, all other player in the raid suffer a smaller portion of this damage if the trap is triggered.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Anub'Rekhan] Dark Gaze no longer increases effected payers physical damage taken.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Anub'Rekhan] Impale now inflicts 50% weapon damage to all enemies in its path. The cast time has been reduced to 1 second down from 2 seconds.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Anub'Rekhan] Crypt Guards Shadow Bolt now inflicts 75% of the targets maximum health as Shadow Damage. Previously inflicted 30000 Shadow Damage.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Anub'Rekhan] Crypt Guards Acid Spit now has a maximum range of 5 yards. Previously had unlimited range.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Anub'Rekhan] Locust Swarm will now last for 3 seconds on player down from 8.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Anub'Rekhan] Locust Swarm now reduces Anub'Rekhans movement speed by 50% up from 40%.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Anub'Rekhan] Anub'Rekhan now casts Locust Swarm every 90 seconds. Previously would cast it on a random timer.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Items] New Item: Fang of the Frost Wyrm, a Main-Hand Fist Weapon dropped from Sapphiron.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Items] Claw of the Frost Wyrm now has a attack speed of 2.6 up from 1.5.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Items] Maul of the redeemed Crusader has its Mp5 converted into Strength at a rate of 2:1.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Items] Iblis, Blade of the fallen Seraph now has a 2.6 speed up from 1.6.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Items] Toxin Injector now has a 3.0 attack speed up from 2.0.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Items] Soulstring now has a 3.0 attack speed up from 2.9.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Items] Wartorn Armor Scraps now have a 1 copper sell price.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Items] Atiesh (Druid) now has a 3.4 attack speed from 3.7. Min and Max damage have been adjusted, the DPS stays the same.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Items] Reduced the Agility on Atiesh (Druid) to 50 from 60.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Items] Splinters of Atiesh now have a progressive higher chance of dropping from bosses further into Naxxramas. Sapphiron is now also able to drop Splinters of Atiesh.

[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Items] Added a heroic version of the Atiesh quest. Note: The heroic version will end and offer its reward after obtaining the staffs head and base. Proper implementation of the Stratholme Quest part comes with a future update.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [Items] Bosses no longer hold Frost Resistance items in their own loot table. They now have a chance to drop Frost resistance items as additional loot.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [General] Corrected multiple issues where summoned creatures inside Naxxramas would spawn with level 80+ health, damage and armor values.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [General] Corrected an issue where Unholy Weapons inside the Military Quarter would become invisible if they got disarmed. Unholy Weapons are now immune to disarm.

[League 2] [Naxxramas] [General] Corrected an issue where Brutal Swipe used by Bone Constructs inside the Military Quarter would not share its damage with all enemies in front of the caster. Brutal Swipe will now share damage between all enemies standing in front of the Bone Construct, excluding pets and totems.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [General] Added a Plague Beast to the Plague Quarter between Heigan the Unclean and Loatheb.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [General] Corrected an issue where Poisonous Skitterer inside the Arachnid Quarter would not be spawned.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [General] All bosses within Naxxramas will no longer follow the parry hasten rules.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [General] All boss encounter now have working checkpoints and unlock checkpoints upon pull rather then kill.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [General] Corrected an issue where Terrifying Presence would reduce a bosses chance to dodge to 0.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [General] Terrifying Presence no longer removes Rallying Cry of the Dragon slayer and Spirit of Zandalar.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [General] At release Terrifying Presence will be enabled on all bosses throughout Naxxramas.
[League 2] [Naxxramas] [General] The Chill of the Necropolis debuff active within Naxxramas no longer increases players health.

[League 2] [Naxxramas] [General] The Argent Dawn stands against the forces of the Lich King. As the fight goes on the heroes daring to enter the unholy halls of Naxxramas will gather power to strike the enemy back. A new aura will be active in Naxxramas increasing players damage dealt, health and healing done over time.

0.description: Pending Restart: Added Tanking and Healing traning dummies to capital cities.
You can now refresh Spectator NPC window with a gossip option.
You can now start Game Modes even when gained experience (but it still requires you to be level 1).

1.description: Fixed an issue where the damage increases from Death Wish and The Beast Within would stack.

0.description: Fixed an issue where sometimes Wild Wrath, Consumed by Fire, and similar enchants would fail to refresh their respected abilities.
Fixed an issue where Blazeguard and Blazefury (Blacksmithing Weapons in TBC) were not trainable and were available with the wrong event cycles. The correct weapons will be visible from the trainers.
Fixed an issue where mass client crashes were able to happen.
You can no longer post invalid (item) hyperlinks in chat.

6.description: Corrected an issue where in rare cases Viscidus could die during his splitting phase, leaving an invisible corpse. If Viscidus dies during his split phase, he now turns visible.

1.description: Fixed an issue where Silence effects would sometimes not remove Burning Determination.

0.description: Pending Restart, Ironmen and Survivalists can use skillcards at level 1 and can receive mail with vanity items in it only. Other items and currency won't be able to be sent to these characters.

1.description: Fixed an issue where Evocation could last longer than intended.

7.description: Pyrolate will now increase the damage done by Immolate in PvP by 5%, down from 15. (PvE increase unchanged.)

0.description: Improved battleground queue system. It will now better prevent uneven teams when a battleground is created.

6.description: [Magtheridon's Lair] [Items] Lebed -o G'urth, the Finger of Death is a Agility version of Bor -o G'urth, the Hand of Death and has an on use effect to summon Bor -o G'urth, the Hand of Death. This will switch out the weapon without losing the weapons enchants.

[Magtheridon's Lair] [Items] Bor -o G'urth, the Hand of Death now has a on use effect, summoning "Lebed -o G'urth, the Finger of Death". This will switch out the weapon without losing the weapons enchants.
[Magtheridon's Lair] [Items] Magtheridon's Glaive has been renamed to "Bor -o G'urth, the Hand of Death".

[Magtheridon's Lair] [Magtheridon] Hand of Death will now use a destination based targeting logic. This doesn't change the function of the ability but improves the tracking for units eligible for sharing damage within the 8 yard radius around the target.
[Magtheridon's Lair] [Magtheridon] Finger of Death will now use a chain based target logic, chaining to an unlimited amount of player within 12 yards of each other.

[Magtheridon's Lair] [Magtheridon] Fel Explosions damage increasing debuff now lasts for 1.1 seconds down from 2 seconds. This should prevent a new Fel Shock from inheriting the previous Fel Shocks aura.
[Magtheridon's Lair] [Magtheridon] Increased the damage of Fel Explosion by 40% on Heroic Difficulty.
[Magtheridon's Lair] [Magtheridon] Collapse Ceiling can no longer miss.
[Magtheridon's Lair] [Magtheridon] Debris can no longer miss.
